overview: A magical, romantic interactive birthday website featuring a beautiful night sky with glowing moon, twinkling stars, drifting clouds, parallax effects, glassmorphism cards, hidden easter eggs, and ambient audio — crafted as a deeply personal birthday gift experience.
features: Night sky with glowing pulsing moon, twinkling stars, and drifting clouds
Hidden Kishor firefly easter egg leading to moonlight message reveal
6-8 deeply romantic 'Reasons I Adore You' glassmorphism cards
'Make a Wish' button with magical light burst animation
Soft ambient night soundscape with mute/unmute toggle
Floating hearts and stardust particles with parallax
Emotional closing message with celebration animation
Mobile-first, fully responsive, all visuals in code
